propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is byte-identical and duplicated across failure.py:148-157 and sizing.py:316-329, creating a maintenance hazard where fixes to one leave the other stale

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain as a def in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py:72 binds it at import time and test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py:45 monkeypatches it by string name

completion_failures.py:46-79 _is_token_exhaustion is a deliberately different classifier that omits bare 'context' substring to avoid false positives and must not be collapsed into the single-sourced tuple

Removing the local tuple from sizing.py and importing from failure._CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS introduces no import cycle since failure.py imports only rebar.llm.errors and sizing.py already imports rebar.llm.config and related modules
A uniqueness guard must match the eight-phrase conjunction in exactly one file under src/rebar (exempting the owner failure.py) and detect reintroduction of duplicate copies via test
